items.q: How should you do shoulder CARs before benching?
items.a: With **almost no weight**, **very slowly**, for 3-5 full controlled circles.

items.q: Where should your shoulders go as the bar leaves your chest?
items.a: **Back into the bench**, pressing away into the pad, not rolling up and forward.
A bench press that **stops just above the chest**, then presses back up.

items.q: How do you use the Spoto press for shoulder pain?
items.a: Stop **before the painful zone**, then **widen the range** over sessions.

items.q: How much of Pana's bench volume stays Spoto press after rehab?
How should you bring the weight back after pain?
items.a: Drop well below your max and add **small steps** (about 10-20 kg) over weeks.

items.q: How do you know the load is right?
items.a: Pain should **fall session to session**; if it doesn't, **go lighter**.
Pain is partly psychological; **pain-free reps** teach the brain the lift is **safe**.
